I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you. When you’ve had letdowns before, it makes the next choice feel a lot higher stakes.

A couple things that may help you feel more at ease about quality here:

All our roses are premium own-root plants we grow ourselves in Oregon (we don’t resell from other nurseries).
Each rose is virus-free, true to variety, and shipped defoliated on purpose so it stays healthy in transit.
We also have a one-year guarantee on roses, because we expect them to perform for you.
